purpose: Read-only table of tile-column (X) positions used to place the character cast in the Chapter 21 end-scene cutscene.
logic_summary: FD2.LE data @ 0x52228. Sole reader fd2_chapter_21_end (@0x240FA): the Watcom prologue copies the 25-byte table onto stack scratch via 6 dwords + 1 trailing byte (MOVSD.REP ECX=6 then MOVSB), then passes the stack pointer as the pos_x argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which reads bytes indexed by character slot. Sits adjacent to the y-position table @ 0x52241 and the facing table @ 0x5225A, each 25 bytes.
